tagline: Every notification mvmOS has raised, in one list.
description:
The notification bell in the taskbar shows the last few. This app shows all of them: the full history from the core and from every installed app, with read and unread status, grouped by day.

It is also where push notifications are configured — how long a toast stays on screen and in which corner of the desktop it appears.
capabilities: Full notification history from the core and from every app.
Filter by read, unread or all, and by normal or push type.
Mark everything read, or delete the whole history.
Open the app a notification came from, straight from the entry.
Set how long a push notification stays on screen (1–30 seconds).
Set which corner of the desktop push notifications appear in.
